summary: An applicant asks whether taking a staff job would let them turn private working files into a public reference.
realLife: Before accepting the assistant parliamentarian post, Riddick asked Watkins for permission to compile Senate precedents for publication.
inGame: needs: job offer and permission to publish an office reference.

turns.what: The applicant submits one subject for review.
turns.pulledBy: The office grants time for a pilot chapter.
Desk duty takes the available hours.
turns.writesBack: The index shows the unfinished subjects.
